title: ARIS Remembers Your Chats
description: ARIS keeps your past chats, markets, deals, goals, and buy box on this account. Open Past chats, start a New chat, or delete a chat.

title: Loan & Lien Records
description: Open a property in the Command Center for recorded loan and lien facts: open loans, lender, rate, and estimated balance.

title: Property Command Center
description: One drawer on a search result for property facts, the market, loan and lien records, the Deal Analyzer, and your CRM.

title: Ask ARIS for Leads
description: Tell ARIS the leads you want, such as free and clear long-term owners in a city, and get a count with a link into Property Search.

title: Property Search Lead List
description: Search free and clear, upside down, cash buyers, long-term owners, zombie properties, and the rest of the lead list.

title: Lease Option, Subject-To, Assumption
description: Those three sit in the Deal Analyzer next to wholesale, flip, and rental. The commercial section inside each one is Empire.

title: Capital Stack
description: Build a starting capital stack for a deal in Capital Radar, then match lenders and draft a private-money pitch.

title: FORGE Cast Comps
description: Recorded sales and a FORGE Cast value from Property Search, ready to send to the Deal Analyzer. A FORGE ARV is an estimate from recorded sales, not an appraisal.
